# ==============================================================================
# Research Project: Hybride Inhaltsanalyse mit Structural Topic Models und Large Language Models am Beispiel chinesischsprachiger Medien außerhalb Festlandchinas
# Main Analysis Pipeline (End-to-End Empirical Analysis: Preprocessing, STM, Validation Integration, Regression, and Visualizations)
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 0: Environment Setup (Install and Load R Packages)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(tidyverse) # Data manipulation and visualization
library(stm)       # Core STM package
library(tm)        # Text mining utilities
library(jiebaR)    # Chinese word segmentation
library(here)      # File path resolution
library(showtext)  # Chinese font handling
library(readxl)    # Reading Excel files
library(writexl)   # Writing Excel files
library(scales)    # Chart axis formatting
library(ggeffects) # Marginal effect predictions
library(broom)     # Model tidying
library(irr)       # Krippendorff's Alpha inter-coder reliability

# --- Font Setup ---
# Load font file to ensure Chinese characters render correctly in plots.
# Configurable via variable 'font_path' or environment variable 'FONT_PATH'.
if (!exists("font_path", inherits = FALSE)) {
  font_candidates <- c(
    Sys.getenv("FONT_PATH", unset = ""),
    file.path("..", "..", "environment", "song.ttf"),
    file.path("environment", "song.ttf")
  )
  font_candidates <- font_candidates[nzchar(font_candidates) & file.exists(font_candidates)]
  font_path <- if (length(font_candidates) > 0) normalizePath(font_candidates[1]) else "song.ttf"
}
if (file.exists(font_path)) {
  font_add("song", regular = font_path)
  showtext_auto()
  print(paste("Song typeface successfully loaded from:", font_path))
} else {
  warning("Font file not found at '", font_path, "'. Chinese characters in plots may not display correctly.")
}

# --- German Display Labels and Formatting Helper Functions ---
funding_labels_de <- c(
  "Other Sources" = "Medien mit anderen Finanzierungsquellen",
  "Foreign Gov-Affiliated" = "Staatlich bzw. öffentlich finanzierte Medien"
)

covariate_labels_de <- function(x) {
  x <- str_replace_all(x, fixed("Funding_SourcesForeign Gov-Affiliated"),
                       paste0("Finanzierungsgruppe: ", funding_labels_de[["Foreign Gov-Affiliated"]]))
  x <- str_replace_all(x, fixed("Funding_SourcesOther Sources"),
                       paste0("Finanzierungsgruppe: ", funding_labels_de[["Other Sources"]]))
  x <- str_replace_all(x, fixed("Is_Taiwan1"), "Taiwan-Medium (ja)")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, fixed("(Intercept)"), "Konstante")
  str_replace_all(x, "Topic_(\\d+)", "Themenanteil \\1")
}

print_model_de <- function(x) {
  output <- capture.output(print(x))
  labels <- c(
    "Top Words:" = "Wichtigste Wörter:",
    "Highest Prob:" = "Höchste Wortwahrscheinlichkeit:",
    "FREX:" = "FREX (Häufigkeit und Exklusivität):",
    "Lift:" = "Relative Überrepräsentation:",
    "Score:" = "Bewertungswert:",
    "Call:" = "Modellaufruf:", "Residuals:" = "Residuen:",
    "Coefficients:" = "Koeffizienten:", "Estimate" = "Schätzwert",
    "Std. Error" = "Standardfehler", "t value" = "t-Wert",
    "Pr(>|t|)" = "p-Wert", "Signif. codes:" = "Signifikanzcodes:",
    "Residual standard error:" = "Residualstandardfehler:",
    "degrees of freedom" = "Freiheitsgrade",
    "Multiple R-squared:" = "Bestimmtheitsmaß R²:",
    "Adjusted R-squared:" = "Korrigiertes R²:",
    "F-statistic:" = "F-Statistik:", "p-value:" = "p-Wert:",
    " DF" = " Freiheitsgrade",
    "Median" = "Median", "1Q" = "1. Quartil", "3Q" = "3. Quartil"
  )
  for (label in names(labels)) {
    output <- str_replace_all(output, fixed(label), labels[[label]])
  }
  output <- str_replace_all(output, "Topic ([0-9]+)", "Thema \\1")
  output <- str_replace_all(output, "\\bon ([0-9]+)", "bei \\1")
  output <- str_replace_all(output, "\\band ([0-9]+)", "und \\1")
  cat(paste(covariate_labels_de(output), collapse = "\n"), "\n")
  invisible(x)
}

  env_base <- Sys.getenv("STM_BASE_DIR", unset = "")
  if (nzchar(env_base)) {
    base_dir <- env_base
  } else {
    candidates <- c(
      file.path("..", "..", "STM"),
      file.path("STM"),
      getwd()
    )
    found_base <- candidates[dir.exists(candidates)]
    base_dir <- if (length(found_base) > 0) normalizePath(found_base[1]) else getwd()
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

      Funding_Sources == "Foreign Government" ~ "Foreign Gov-Affiliated",
      Funding_Sources == "Independent Media" ~ "Other Sources",

all_articles$Is_Taiwan <- as.factor(all_articles$Is_Taiwan)

# Initialize Jieba tokenizer and load custom nouns
segment_engine <- worker()

segment_text <- function(text) {
  if (is.na(text) || !is.character(text)) return("")
  segmented_words <- segment(text, segment_engine)
  return(paste(segmented_words, collapse = " "))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 2.4: Pre- and Post-Cleaning Statistical Report (Export German Version)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
print("Generating pre- and post-cleaning statistical report...")

# 1. Pre-cleaning statistics (based on all_articles)
all_articles <- all_articles %>%
  mutate(char_count_pre = nchar(Text, type = "chars"))

stats_pre_funding <- all_articles %>%
  group_by(Funding_Sources) %>%
  summarise(
    Pre_Clean_Articles = n(),
    Pre_Clean_Chars = sum(char_count_pre, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stats_pre_media <- all_articles %>%
  group_by(Funding_Sources, `Media Name`) %>%
  summarise(
    Pre_Clean_Articles = n(),
    Pre_Clean_Chars = sum(char_count_pre, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Funding_Sources, desc(Pre_Clean_Articles))

# 2. Post-cleaning statistics (based on out$meta and out$documents)
calc_clean_chars <- function(doc_matrix, vocab_list) {
  if (length(doc_matrix) == 0) return(0)
  if (is.null(dim(doc_matrix))) {
    word_indices <- doc_matrix[1]
    word_counts <- doc_matrix[2]
  } else {
    word_indices <- doc_matrix[1, ]
    word_counts <- doc_matrix[2, ]
  }
  words <- vocab_list[word_indices]
  sum(nchar(words, type = "chars") * word_counts, na.rm = TRUE)
}

clean_chars_list <- sapply(out$documents, calc_clean_chars, vocab_list = out$vocab)

meta_clean <- out$meta %>%
  mutate(char_count_post = clean_chars_list)

stats_post_funding <- meta_clean %>%
  group_by(Funding_Sources) %>%
  summarise(
    Post_Clean_Articles = n(),
    Post_Clean_Chars = sum(char_count_post, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stats_post_media <- meta_clean %>%
  group_by(Funding_Sources, `Media Name`) %>%
  summarise(
    Post_Clean_Articles = n(),
    Post_Clean_Chars = sum(char_count_post, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Funding_Sources, desc(Post_Clean_Articles))

# 3. Merge comparison results and construct unified report
summary_media <- stats_pre_media %>%
  left_join(stats_post_media, by = c("Funding_Sources", "Media Name")) %>%
  mutate(
    Post_Clean_Articles = replace_na(Post_Clean_Articles, 0),
    Post_Clean_Chars = replace_na(Post_Clean_Chars, 0)
  )

summary_media_formatted <- summary_media %>%
  mutate(
    Category = as.character(Funding_Sources),
    `Diff Characters` = Pre_Clean_Chars - Post_Clean_Chars
  ) %>%
  select(
    Category,
    Media = `Media Name`,
    `Pre-Clean Articles` = Pre_Clean_Articles,
    `Pre-Clean Characters` = Pre_Clean_Chars,
    `Post-Clean Articles` = Post_Clean_Articles,
    `Post-Clean Characters` = Post_Clean_Chars,
    `Diff Characters`
  ) %>%
  arrange(Category, desc(`Pre-Clean Articles`))

foreign_media <- summary_media_formatted %>% filter(Category == "Foreign Gov-Affiliated")
other_media <- summary_media_formatted %>% filter(Category == "Other Sources")

foreign_total <- foreign_media %>%
  summarise(
    Category = "Foreign Gov-Affiliated",
    Media = "Foreign Gov-Affiliated (Total)",
    `Pre-Clean Articles` = sum(`Pre-Clean Articles`),
    `Pre-Clean Characters` = sum(`Pre-Clean Characters`),
    `Post-Clean Articles` = sum(`Post-Clean Articles`),
    `Post-Clean Characters` = sum(`Post-Clean Characters`),
    `Diff Characters` = sum(`Diff Characters`)
  )

other_total <- other_media %>%
  summarise(
    Category = "Other Sources",
    Media = "Other Sources (Total)",
    `Pre-Clean Articles` = sum(`Pre-Clean Articles`),
    `Pre-Clean Characters` = sum(`Pre-Clean Characters`),
    `Post-Clean Articles` = sum(`Post-Clean Articles`),
    `Post-Clean Characters` = sum(`Post-Clean Characters`),
    `Diff Characters` = sum(`Diff Characters`)
  )

overall_total <- summary_media_formatted %>%
  summarise(
    Category = "All",
    Media = "Total",
    `Pre-Clean Articles` = sum(`Pre-Clean Articles`),
    `Pre-Clean Characters` = sum(`Pre-Clean Characters`),
    `Post-Clean Articles` = sum(`Post-Clean Articles`),

final_report <- bind_rows(

) %>% select(-Category)

final_report_de <- final_report %>%
  mutate(Media = recode(Media,

  rename(

write_xlsx(final_report_de, file.path(results_dir, "data_cleaning_stats_loc.xlsx"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 3: Diagnostic Selection of Optimal Number of Topics (K) [German 4-Panel Plot]
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Note: SearchK computation is time-consuming. If local checkpoint exists, load directly;
# To recompute, set recompute_search_k to TRUE.
recompute_search_k <- FALSE
checkpoint_k_file <- file.path(results_dir, "search_k_result_loc.RData")

if (file.exists(checkpoint_k_file) && !recompute_search_k) {
  print("Existing SearchK checkpoint detected (search_k_result_loc.RData), loading directly...")
  load(checkpoint_k_file)
} else {
  print("Executing SearchK diagnostic computation (testing K = 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30)...")
  search_k_result <- searchK(
    documents = out$documents,
    vocab = out$vocab,
    K = c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30),
    prevalence = ~ Funding_Sources + Is_Taiwan,
    data = out$meta,
    init.type = "Spectral",
    verbose = TRUE
  )
  save(search_k_result, file = checkpoint_k_file)
  print("SearchK diagnostic results saved to search_k_result_loc.RData.")
}

# Generate 4-panel German diagnostic plot (top-tier journal typesetting, left-aligned unboxed title, uniform color palette, K=20 anchor highlighted)
plot_search_k_de <- function(x, opt_k = 20) {
  k_df <- data.frame(
    K = as.numeric(unlist(x$results$K)),
    heldout = as.numeric(unlist(x$results$heldout)),
    residual = as.numeric(unlist(x$results$residual)),
    semcoh = as.numeric(unlist(x$results$semcoh)),
    lbound = as.numeric(unlist(x$results$lbound))
  )
  
  k_long <- k_df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(heldout, residual, semcoh, lbound), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(
      metric_label = factor(
        metric,
        levels = c("heldout", "residual", "semcoh", "lbound"),
        labels = c(
          "A   Held-out-Likelihood",
          "B   Residualdispersion",
          "C   Semantische Kohärenz",
          "D   Variationsuntergrenze (ELBO)"
        )
      )
    )
  
  col_primary <- "#1B7A60"  # Uniform deep pine green
  col_muted   <- "#9CA3AF"  # Reference dashed line gray
  
  p <- ggplot(k_long, aes(x = K, y = value)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = opt_k, linetype = "dashed", color = col_muted, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(color = col_primary, linewidth = 1.05) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3.2, fill = "white", color = col_primary, stroke = 1.4) +
    geom_point(data = filter(k_long, K == opt_k),
               shape = 21, size = 4.6, fill = col_primary, color = "white", stroke = 1.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(5, 30, by = 5)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
    labs(
      title = "Diagnosekennzahlen zur Wahl der Themenanzahl (K)",
      subtitle = "Optimaler Modellkompromiss gewählt bei K = 20 (Trade-off zwischen Kohärenz und Modellpassung)",
      x = "Anzahl der Themen (K)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "sans"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "#111827", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 4)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11.5, color = "#4B5563", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 16)),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, color = "#1F2937", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 2, b = 8)),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "#D1D5DB", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#F3F4F6", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12.5, color = "#1F2937", margin = margin(t = 12)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "#374151"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#9CA3AF", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
      panel.spacing.x = unit(1.8, "lines"),
      panel.spacing.y = unit(1.8, "lines"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 16, r = 24, b = 16, l = 20)
    )
  return(p)
}

p_search_k <- plot_search_k_de(search_k_result, opt_k = K_selected)
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "search_k_result_loc.png"), plot = p_search_k, width = 10, height = 7.2, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 4: Fit Final STM Model (with Is_Taiwan Covariate)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
K_selected <- 20 # 20 topics selected according to research specifications

stm_model <- stm(
  documents = out$documents,
  vocab = out$vocab,
  K = K_selected, 
  prevalence = ~ Funding_Sources + Is_Taiwan,
  max.em.its = 200, 
  data = out$meta,
  init.type = "Spectral",
  seed = 42
)

if (stm_model$convergence$converged) {
  print("Model fitting complete and successfully converged.")
} else {
  warning("Model failed to converge. Please increase max.em.its and re-fit.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 5.2 Estimate Metadata Effects on Topic Prevalence (Controlling for Is_Taiwan)
effect <- estimateEffect(
  formula = 1:K_selected ~ Funding_Sources + Is_Taiwan,
  stmobj = stm_model,
  meta = out$meta,
  uncertainty = "Global"
)
summary_effect <- summary(effect)

# 5.3 Export Effects Summary Table (German Labels)
tables_list <- summary_effect$tables
final_results <- map_dfr(tables_list, ~ as.data.frame(.) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Covariate"), .id = "Topic") %>%
  filter(!str_detect(Covariate, "Intercept")) %>%
  mutate(
    Topic = as.integer(str_remove(Topic, "Topic ")),
    Covariate_DE = covariate_labels_de(Covariate),
    p.value_formatted = scales::pvalue(`Pr(>|t|)`, accuracy = 0.001)
  ) %>%
  select(
    `Topic_Num` = Topic,
    `Covariate` = Covariate_DE,
    `Estimate_Gamma` = Estimate,
    `Std_Error` = `Std. Error`,
    `p_value` = p.value_formatted
  ) %>%
  arrange(`Topic_Num`)

write_xlsx(final_results, file.path(results_dir, "stm_effects_summary_loc.xlsx"))
print("Effects summary table exported to stm_effects_summary_loc.xlsx.")

# 5.4 Extract Topic Prevalence Effect Plot Data (Funding Sources after Controlling for Taiwan Covariate)
plot_data <- purrr::map_dfr(summary_effect$tables, function(topic_table) {
  # Dynamically match Funding_Sources coefficient row
  target_row <- topic_table[grepl("Funding_Sources", rownames(topic_table)), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(target_row) > 0) {
    row_name <- rownames(target_row)[1]
    raw_est <- target_row[, "Estimate"]
    se <- target_row[, "Std. Error"]
    
    # Automatic baseline alignment: ensures positive values indicate higher prevalence in foreign state-affiliated media
    est <- ifelse(grepl("Other Sources", row_name), -raw_est, raw_est)
    
    tibble(
      estimate = est,
      conf.low = est - 1.96 * se,
      conf.high = est + 1.96 * se,
      p.value = target_row[, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  } else {
    tibble(estimate = NA, conf.low = NA, conf.high = NA, p.value = NA)
  }
}, .id = "topic") %>%
  mutate(
    significant = p.value < 0.05,
    topic_num = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(topic, "Topic |[[:space:]]"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(topic_num)) %>%
  mutate(topic_label = factor(topic, levels = unique(topic)))

# Draw German effect distribution plot with topic numbers (my_final_plot_loc.png)

  mutate(
    label_text = paste("Thema", topic_num),
    label_side = ifelse(estimate >= 0, "right", "left"),
    label_x = ifelse(label_side == "right", conf.high + 0.005, conf.low - 0.005),
    label_hjust = ifelse(label_side == "right", 0, 1)
  )

p_to_tweak <- ggplot(plot_data_short, aes(x = estimate, y = topic_label)) +

print("Constructing LLM sample pool and extracting posterior topic matrix...")

# Helper function: Export portable HTML reader
export_to_html_reader <- function(df, file_path, title_text) {
  html_content <- c(
    "<html><head><meta charset='utf-8'><style>",
    "body { font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 800px; margin: auto; padding: 20px; color: #333; }",
    "h1 { text-align: center; color: #2c3e50; }",
    ".article { border-bottom: 2px solid #eee; padding-bottom: 20px; margin-bottom: 30px; }",
    ".meta { color: #7f8c8d; font-size: 0.9em; margin-bottom: 15px; }",
    ".content { font-size: 1.1em; text-align: justify; }",
    "</style></head><body>",
    paste0("<h1>", title_text, "</h1>")
  )
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(df)) {
    article_html <- paste0(
      "<div class='article'>",
      "<h2>[", i, "] ", df$Title[i], "</h2>",
      "<div class='meta'>",
      "<b>Dokument-ID:</b> ", df$Doc_ID[i],
      "</div>",
      "<div class='content'>", gsub("\n", "<br>", df$Text[i]), "</div>",
      "</div>"
    )
    html_content <- c(html_content, article_html)
  }
  html_content <- c(html_content, "</body></html>")
  writeLines(html_content, file_path, useBytes = TRUE)
}

rr_meta <- meta
rr_meta$Doc_ID <- 1:nrow(rr_meta)
rr_theta <- stm_model$theta

theta_df <- as.data.frame(stm_model$theta)
colnames(theta_df) <- paste0("Topic_", 1:ncol(theta_df))

meta_for_llm_full <- bind_cols(meta, theta_df) %>%
  mutate(Doc_ID = row_number())

if (current_seed == "42") {
  # 6.1 Extract 30 development samples for prompt tuning (20 typical cases + 10 high-entropy cases)
  tuning_sample_path <- file.path(results_dir, "rich_range_sample_for_LLM_tuning_loc.xlsx")
  if (file.exists(tuning_sample_path)) {
    print("Existing prompt-tuning sample detected, loading directly to maintain alignment...")
    rich_range_sample_30 <- read_excel(tuning_sample_path)
  } else {
    typical_cases_idx <- apply(rr_theta, 2, which.max)
    typical_cases <- rr_meta[typical_cases_idx, ]
    typical_cases$Sample_Type <- paste0("Typischer Fall (Thema ", 1:K_selected, ")")

    rr_meta$Entropy <- apply(rr_theta, 1, function(p) {
      -sum(p * log(p + 1e-9))
    })

    ambiguous_cases <- rr_meta %>%
      filter(!Doc_ID %in% typical_cases$Doc_ID) %>% 
      arrange(desc(Entropy)) %>%                    
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%                        
      mutate(Sample_Type = "Mehrdeutiger Fall (hohe Entropie)")

    rich_range_sample_30 <- bind_rows(typical_cases, ambiguous_cases)
    export_rr_data <- rich_range_sample_30 %>% select(Doc_ID, Title, Text)
    write_xlsx(export_rr_data, tuning_sample_path)
    export_to_html_reader(export_rr_data, file.path(results_dir, "rich_range_sample_for_LLM_tuning_loc.html"), "LLM Prompt Tuning Development Sample (Entwicklungsstichprobe mit breitem Fallspektrum)")
  }

  # Export blank coding template for human prompt tuning (if not exists)
  human_tuning_path <- file.path(results_dir, "human_coded_tuning_loc.xlsx")
  if (!file.exists(human_tuning_path)) {
    export_rr_human <- rich_range_sample_30 %>% select(Doc_ID, Title, Text) %>% mutate(Human_Score = NA)
    write_xlsx(export_rr_human, human_tuning_path)
  }

  # 6.2 Extract 100-article Gold Standard Random Validation Sample
  val_sample_path <- file.path(results_dir, "random_validation_sample_loc.xlsx")
  if (file.exists(val_sample_path)) {
    print("Existing validation sample detected, loading directly to maintain alignment...")
    random_validation_sample <- read_excel(val_sample_path)
  } else {
    set.seed(123)
    random_validation_sample <- rr_meta %>%
      filter(!Doc_ID %in% rich_range_sample_30$Doc_ID) %>%
      slice_sample(n = 100) %>%
      mutate(Sample_Type = "Zufallsstichprobe zur Validierung (manueller Referenzstandard)")

    export_val_data <- random_validation_sample %>% select(Doc_ID, Title, Text)
    write_xlsx(export_val_data, val_sample_path)
    export_to_html_reader(export_val_data, file.path(results_dir, "random_validation_sample_loc.html"), "Human Coded Random Validation Sample (Referenzstandard)")
  }

  # Export blank coding template for human validation (if not exists)
  human_val_path <- file.path(results_dir, "human_coded_validation_loc.xlsx")
  if (!file.exists(human_val_path)) {
    export_val_human <- random_validation_sample %>% select(Doc_ID, Title, Text) %>% mutate(Human_Score = NA)
    write_xlsx(export_val_human, human_val_path)
  }

  # 6.3 Export Remaining Unlabeled Sample for Automated LLM Batch Scoring
  output_path_remaining <- file.path(results_dir, "remaining_sample_for_LLM_scoring_loc.xlsx")
  remaining_sample <- meta_for_llm_full %>%
    filter(!Doc_ID %in% rich_range_sample_30$Doc_ID) %>%
    filter(!Doc_ID %in% random_validation_sample$Doc_ID) %>%
    select(Doc_ID, Title, Text)

  if (!file.exists(output_path_remaining)) {
    write_xlsx(remaining_sample, output_path_remaining)
    print(paste("Remaining automated scoring sample exported to:", output_path_remaining))
  }

  # 6.4 (Optional) Prompt Tuning Error Analysis
  tuning_human_file <- file.path(results_dir, "human_coded_tuning_loc.xlsx")
  tuning_llm_file <- file.path(results_dir, "llm_scored_tuning_loc.xlsx")
  if (file.exists(tuning_human_file) && file.exists(tuning_llm_file)) {
    df_human_tune <- read_excel(tuning_human_file) %>% select(Doc_ID, Human_Score)
    df_llm_tune <- read_excel(tuning_llm_file) %>% select(Doc_ID, LLM_Score, LLM_Reasoning, Text)
    
    error_analysis_df <- inner_join(df_human_tune, df_llm_tune, by = "Doc_ID") %>%
      filter(!is.na(Human_Score) & !is.na(LLM_Score)) %>%
      filter(Human_Score != LLM_Score)
    
    if(nrow(error_analysis_df) > 0) {
      error_output_path <- file.path(results_dir, "prompt_tuning_error_analysis.xlsx")
      write_xlsx(error_analysis_df, error_output_path)
      print(paste("Prompt tuning error cases exported to:", error_output_path))
    }
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 7: Inter-Coder Reliability (Validation) and Classification Metrics
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  print("=== Phase A: Reliability and Classification Performance Validation ===")
  val_human_path <- file.path(results_dir, "human_coded_validation_loc.xlsx")
  val_llm_path <- file.path(results_dir, "llm_scored_validation_loc.xlsx")

  if (file.exists(val_human_path) && file.exists(val_llm_path)) {
    human_val <- read_excel(val_human_path) %>% select(Doc_ID, Human_Score)
    llm_val <- read_excel(val_llm_path) %>% select(Doc_ID, LLM_Score)
    
    val_script <- file.path(local_dir, "validation_metrics.R")
    if (file.exists(val_script)) {
      source(val_script)
    } else {
      calculate_validation_metrics <- function(human_val, llm_val) {
        val_check <- inner_join(human_val, llm_val, by = "Doc_ID") %>%
          mutate(Human_Score = as.numeric(Human_Score), LLM_Score = as.numeric(LLM_Score)) %>%
          filter(!is.na(Human_Score), !is.na(LLM_Score))
        nominal_alpha <- function(h, l) irr::kripp.alpha(rbind(h, l), method = "nominal")$value
        applicable_h <- val_check$Human_Score != -99
        applicable_l <- val_check$LLM_Score != -99
        stance_check <- val_check[applicable_h & applicable_l, ]
        summary <- data.frame(
          Task = c("Joint labels (nominal)", "Target applicability (nominal)", "Stance, both applicable (nominal)"),
          N = c(nrow(val_check), nrow(val_check), nrow(stance_check)),
          Alpha = c(nominal_alpha(val_check$Human_Score, val_check$LLM_Score),
                    nominal_alpha(as.integer(applicable_h), as.integer(applicable_l)),
                    nominal_alpha(stance_check$Human_Score, stance_check$LLM_Score)),
          Accuracy = c(mean(val_check$Human_Score == val_check$LLM_Score),
                       mean(applicable_h == applicable_l),
                       if (nrow(stance_check) > 0) mean(stance_check$Human_Score == stance_check$LLM_Score) else NA_real_)
        )
        classes <- c(-99, -1, 0, 1)
        metrics <- do.call(rbind, lapply(classes, function(cl) {
          tp <- sum(val_check$Human_Score == cl & val_check$LLM_Score == cl)
          support <- sum(val_check$Human_Score == cl)
          pred <- sum(val_check$LLM_Score == cl)
          data.frame(
            Class = cl, Support = support, Predicted = pred,
            Precision = if (pred > 0) tp / pred else NA_real_,
            Recall = if (support > 0) tp / support else NA_real_,
            F1 = if (support + pred > 0) 2 * tp / (support + pred) else NA_real_
          )
        }))
        confusion <- table(Human = factor(val_check$Human_Score, levels = classes),
                           LLM = factor(val_check$LLM_Score, levels = classes))
        list(val_check = val_check, summary = summary, metrics = metrics, confusion = confusion)
      }
    }
    
    validation <- calculate_validation_metrics(human_val, llm_val)
    val_check <- validation$val_check
    
    if (nrow(val_check) > 0) {
      alpha_val <- round(validation$summary$Alpha[1], 4)
      print("Inter-coder agreement and accuracy (Krippendorff's Alpha on nominal scale):")
      validation_summary_de <- validation$summary %>%
        mutate(Task = recode(Task,
          "Joint labels (nominal)" = "Vierstufige Codierung (nominal)",
          "Target applicability (nominal)" = "Anwendbarkeit der zielbezogenen Codierung (nominal)",
          "Stance, both applicable (nominal)" = "Stance-Klassifikation bei beidseitiger Anwendbarkeit (nominal)")) %>%
        rename(Aufgabe = Task, Stichprobenumfang = N,
               `Krippendorffs Alpha` = Alpha, Klassifikationsgenauigkeit = Accuracy)
      print(validation_summary_de, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
      
      print("=== Phase A Supplementary Validation: Machine Learning Classification Performance (F1-Score) ===")
      metrics <- validation$metrics
      print("Model precision, recall, and F1-score on the validation set:")
      metrics_de <- metrics %>%
        rename(Klasse = Class, `Fallzahl (n)` = Support,
               `Vorhergesagte Häufigkeit` = Predicted,
               Präzision = Precision, Recall = Recall, `F1-Maß` = F1)
      print(metrics_de, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
      
      cm_data <- as.data.frame(validation$confusion)
      p_cm <- ggplot(data = cm_data, mapping = aes(x = LLM, y = Human)) +
        geom_tile(aes(fill = Freq), color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
        geom_text(
          aes(
            label = sprintf("%d", Freq),
            color = Freq > max(Freq) * 0.45
          ),
          size = 8.5,
          fontface = "bold",
          vjust = 0.5
        ) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white", "FALSE" = "#1F2937"), guide = "none") +
        scale_fill_gradient(
          low = "#F4FAF7",
          high = "#1B7A60",
          name = "Häufigkeit",
          breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)
        ) +
        scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
        labs(
          title = "Konfusionsmatrix: Manuelle vs. LLM-basierte Codierung",
          subtitle = "Vergleich der manuellen Referenzcodierung mit den LLM-Klassifikationen (N = 100)",
          x = "LLM-Klassifikation",
          y = "Manuelle Referenzcodierung",
          caption = "Kategorien: −99 = Nicht anwendbar | −1 = Ablehnend | 0 = Neutral | +1 = Befürwortend"
        ) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
        theme(
          text = element_text(family = "sans"),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 17, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 6), color = "#111827"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12.5, hjust = 0.5, color = "#4B5563", margin = margin(b = 16)),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "#6B7280", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 12)),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "#1F2937", margin = margin(t = 12)),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "#1F2937", margin = margin(r = 12)),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13.5, face = "bold", color = "#1F2937"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13.5, face = "bold", color = "#1F2937"),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold", color = "#1F2937", margin = margin(b = 8)),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 11.5, color = "#374151"),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_rect(colour = "#374151", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 16, r = 18, b = 14, l = 16)
        )
      
      png_path <- file.path(results_dir, "Confusion_Matrix_Heatmap.png")
      ggsave(png_path, plot = p_cm, width = 7.5, height = 6.4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
      print(paste("Confusion matrix heatmap saved to:", png_path))
    }
  } else {
    warning("Validation scoring files not detected. Please verify that human_coded_validation_loc.xlsx and llm_scored_validation_loc.xlsx exist in results_dir.")
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 8: Final Score Backfill and Data Merging (Final Data Consolidation)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  print("Merging final LLM stance scores...")
  remaining_llm_path <- file.path(results_dir, "llm_scored_remaining_loc.xlsx")

  if (file.exists(remaining_llm_path) && file.exists(val_llm_path)) {
    llm_remaining <- read_excel(remaining_llm_path) %>% select(Doc_ID, LLM_Score)
    llm_val <- read_excel(val_llm_path) %>% select(Doc_ID, LLM_Score)
    all_llm_scores <- bind_rows(llm_val, llm_remaining)
    df_final <- meta_for_llm_full %>%
      inner_join(all_llm_scores, by = "Doc_ID") %>%
      mutate(Final_Stance = as.numeric(LLM_Score)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Final_Stance), Final_Stance != -99)
    print(paste("Successfully merged final dataset. After excluding missing scores and non-applicable targets (-99), valid regression sample size is:", nrow(df_final)))
  } else {
    stop("Final scoring files missing. Please verify that llm_scored_remaining_loc.xlsx and llm_scored_validation_loc.xlsx are generated.")
  }
} else {
  print(paste("=== Robustness Resampling Mode (Seed", current_seed, ") ==="))
  export_remaining_data <- meta_for_llm_full %>% select(Doc_ID, Title, Text)
  full_sample_path <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("full_sample_for_llm_seed_", current_seed, ".xlsx"))
  write_xlsx(export_remaining_data, full_sample_path)
  print(paste("Full sample (", nrow(export_remaining_data), "articles) saved to:", full_sample_path))
  
  # Step 8: Robustness Sample Full Score Backfill and Data Merging
  print("Reading robustness LLM scoring results for final data consolidation...")
  llm_final_path <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("llm_scored_full_seed_", current_seed, ".xlsx"))
  if (file.exists(llm_final_path)) {
    llm_remaining <- read_excel(llm_final_path) %>% select(Doc_ID, LLM_Score)
    df_final <- meta_for_llm_full %>%
      inner_join(llm_remaining, by = "Doc_ID") %>%
      mutate(Final_Stance = as.numeric(LLM_Score)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Final_Stance), Final_Stance != -99)
    print(paste("Successfully merged robustness sample data. After excluding missing scores and non-applicable targets (-99), valid regression sample size is:", nrow(df_final)))
  } else {
    stop(paste("Robustness scoring file not found:", llm_final_path))
  }
}

# Factor preprocessing: Explicitly set comparison baseline for funding sources
df_final$Funding_Sources <- as.factor(df_final$Funding_Sources)
if ("Other Sources" %in% levels(df_final$Funding_Sources)) {
  df_final$Funding_Sources <- relevel(df_final$Funding_Sources, ref = "Other Sources")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 9: Baseline Topic Diagnostics and Automated Selection
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
print("Initiating baseline topic diagnostic procedure...")

topic_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  Topic_Num = 1:K_selected,
  Mean_Prevalence = numeric(K_selected), # Global topic prevalence
  P_Value_Diff = numeric(K_selected),    # P-value of distribution difference across media groups
  T_Stat_Diff = numeric(K_selected)      # Absolute t-statistic of group difference
)

for (i in 1:K_selected) {
  topic_col <- paste0("Topic_", i)
  
  # a. Calculate mean prevalence of this topic across all documents
  topic_diagnostics$Mean_Prevalence[i] <- mean(df_final[[topic_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # b. Run bivariate regression to test significance
  temp_formula <- as.formula(paste(topic_col, "~ Funding_Sources"))
  temp_summary <- summary(lm(temp_formula, data = df_final))
  
  # c. Extract Funding_Sources coefficient statistics (p-value and t-statistic)
  coef_row_idx <- grep("Funding_Sources", rownames(temp_summary$coefficients))
  
  if(length(coef_row_idx) > 0) {
    topic_diagnostics$P_Value_Diff[i] <- temp_summary$coefficients[coef_row_idx, 4]
    topic_diagnostics$T_Stat_Diff[i] <- abs(temp_summary$coefficients[coef_row_idx, 3])
  } else {
    topic_diagnostics$P_Value_Diff[i] <- NA
    topic_diagnostics$T_Stat_Diff[i] <- NA
  }
}

# Sort by agenda balance (higher p-value indicates smaller inter-group agenda difference, more suitable as baseline)
topic_diagnostics <- topic_diagnostics %>% arrange(desc(P_Value_Diff))

print("=== Baseline Topic Candidate Ranking (Descending by P-value) ===")
print(topic_diagnostics %>%
  rename(Thema = Topic_Num, `Mittlerer Themenanteil` = Mean_Prevalence,
         `p-Wert des Gruppenunterschieds` = P_Value_Diff,
         `Absoluter t-Wert` = T_Stat_Diff))

if (current_seed == "42") {
  # Set threshold: Filter balanced topics with mean prevalence > 5%, select top-ranked topic as baseline
  candidate_topics <- topic_diagnostics %>% filter(Mean_Prevalence > 0.05)
  optimal_baseline_num <- candidate_topics$Topic_Num[1]
} else {
  # Robustness check: Find most balanced control topic not significantly associated with covariates
  p_values_df <- data.frame(Topic = paste0("Topic_", seq_len(K_selected)), Max_P_Value = NA_real_)
  for (i in seq_len(K_selected)) {
    topic_name <- paste0("Topic_", i)
    f <- as.formula(paste(topic_name, "~ Funding_Sources + Is_Taiwan"))
    m <- lm(f, data = df_final)
    p_values_df$Max_P_Value[i] <- max(summary(m)$coefficients[-1, 4])
  }
  candidate_topics <- p_values_df %>% arrange(desc(Max_P_Value)) %>%
    mutate(Topic_Num = as.numeric(gsub("Topic_", "", Topic)))
  optimal_baseline_num <- candidate_topics$Topic_Num[1]
}

print(paste("Selected optimal baseline topic according to statistical criteria: Topic", optimal_baseline_num))

# Construct dynamic control topics formula string (excluding selected baseline topic)
control_topics_nums <- setdiff(1:K_selected, optimal_baseline_num)
control_topics_formula_str <- paste(paste0("Topic_", control_topics_nums), collapse = " + ")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 10: Regression Analysis and Model Comparison
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# --- [Model 1: Baseline Model (Basismodell)] ---
formula_p1 <- as.formula("Final_Stance ~ Funding_Sources + Is_Taiwan")
model_p1 <- lm(formula_p1, data = df_final)

print("=== Model 1: Baseline Main Effect Regression Results ===")
print_model_de(summary(model_p1))

# --- [Model 2: Structural Topic Confounder Control Model (Themenkontrolle)] ---
formula_p2 <- as.formula(paste("Final_Stance ~ Funding_Sources + Is_Taiwan +", control_topics_formula_str))
model_p2 <- lm(formula_p2, data = df_final)

print("=== Model 2: Confounder-Controlled Regression Results ===")
print_model_de(summary(model_p2))

# --- [Model Comparison: Adjusted R² Comparison between M1 and M2] ---
adj_r2_m1 <- summary(model_p1)$adj.r.squared
adj_r2_m2 <- summary(model_p2)$adj.r.squared

cat("=== Vergleich des korrigierten R² zwischen Modell 1 und Modell 2 ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Modell 1 (Basismodell M1) Korrigiertes R²: %.4f (R²: %.4f)\n", adj_r2_m1, summary(model_p1)$r.squared))
cat(sprintf("Modell 2 (Themenkontrolle M2) Korrigiertes R²: %.4f (R²: %.4f)\n", adj_r2_m2, summary(model_p2)$r.squared))
cat(sprintf("Δ Korrigiertes R² (M2 - M1): %.4f (Δ R²: %.4f)\n", adj_r2_m2 - adj_r2_m1, summary(model_p2)$r.squared - summary(model_p1)$r.squared))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 11: High-Quality Academic Visualizations (Standard Plots)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# [Figure 1] Model 1: Unadjusted Media Stance Difference (without topic controls)

  mutate(x = factor(x, levels = c("Other Sources", "Foreign Gov-Affiliated"), 
                    labels = c("Medien mit anderen\nFinanzierungsquellen", "Staatlich bzw. öffentlich\nfinanzierte Medien")))

    title = "Modell 1: Vorhergesagter Stance-Wert nach Finanzierungsquelle",

  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "sans"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 15.5, margin = margin(b = 6)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13, color = "grey35", margin = margin(b = 18)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, margin = margin(r = 15)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black", lineheight = 1.2),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11.5, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 25, b = 20, l = 20)
  )
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "Path1_Model1_Predicted_Stance_loc.png"), plot = plot_m1, width = 8.5, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# [Figure 2] Model 2: Adjusted Media Stance Difference (controlling for structural topics)
pred_m2_df <- as.data.frame(ggpredict(model_p2, terms = "Funding_Sources")) %>%
  mutate(x = factor(x, levels = c("Other Sources", "Foreign Gov-Affiliated"), 
                    labels = c("Medien mit anderen\nFinanzierungsquellen", "Staatlich bzw. öffentlich\nfinanzierte Medien")))

plot_m2 <- ggplot(pred_m2_df, aes(x = x, y = predicted)) +

  ) +

# [Figure 3] Finanzierungsgruppenvergleich vor und nach Themenkontrolle
# BEGIN FUNDING_COEFFICIENT_SLOPE
# Finanzierungsgruppenvergleich vor und nach Themenkontrolle.
# Alle Beschriftungen und Unsicherheiten werden aus den uebergebenen Modellen abgeleitet.
make_funding_coefficient_plot <- function(model_m1, model_m2) {
  term <- "Funding_SourcesForeign Gov-Affiliated"
  extract <- function(model, model_id, x) {
    sm <- summary(model)
    if (sum(rownames(sm$coefficients) == term) != 1L) {
      stop("Der Finanzierungskoeffizient fehlt oder ist nicht eindeutig.")
    }
    ci <- stats::confint(model, parm = term, level = 0.95)
    data.frame(
      model = model_id, x = x, estimate = unname(stats::coef(model)[term]),
      conf_low = ci[1, 1], conf_high = ci[1, 2],
      p_value = sm$coefficients[term, "Pr(>|t|)"],
      n_articles = stats::nobs(model), adjusted_r2 = sm$adj.r.squared,
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }
  dat <- rbind(extract(model_m1, "M1", 1), extract(model_m2, "M2", 2))
  stopifnot(
    identical(rownames(stats::model.frame(model_m1)), rownames(stats::model.frame(model_m2))),
    dat$n_articles[1] == dat$n_articles[2],
    all(is.finite(as.matrix(dat[, c("estimate", "conf_low", "conf_high", "p_value")]))),
    all(dat$conf_low < dat$estimate), all(dat$estimate < dat$conf_high),
    all((dat$p_value < 0.05) == (dat$conf_low > 0 | dat$conf_high < 0))
  )
  decimal <- function(x, digits = 4, signed = FALSE) {
    fmt <- paste0(if (signed) "%+." else "%.", digits, "f")
    gsub(".", ",", sprintf(fmt, x), fixed = TRUE)
  }
  topic_count <- sum(grepl("^Topic_", names(stats::coef(model_m2))))
  sample_label <- format(dat$n_articles[1], big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
  font_family <- if (requireNamespace("systemfonts", quietly = TRUE) &&
                     "Arial" %in% systemfonts::system_fonts()$family) "Arial" else "sans"
  dat$estimate_label <- decimal(dat$estimate, signed = TRUE)
  dat$ci_label <- paste0("[", decimal(dat$conf_low), "; ", decimal(dat$conf_high), "]")
  dat$p_label <- ifelse(dat$p_value < 0.001, "p < 0,001", paste0("p = ", decimal(dat$p_value, 3)))
  dat$label_x <- c(0.90, 2.10)
  dat$hjust <- c(1, 0)
  dat$estimate_y <- dat$estimate + c(0.014, 0.001)
  dat$ci_y <- dat$estimate + c(-0.009, -0.022)
  dat$p_y <- dat$estimate + c(-0.032, -0.045)
  # Bei einem positiven M2-Koeffizienten steht der ganze Textblock oberhalb der Nulllinie.
  # So kann die Referenzlinie keine der drei Zahlenbeschriftungen kreuzen.
  if (dat$estimate[2] > 0) {
    dat$p_y[2] <- max(0.015, dat$p_y[2])
    dat$ci_y[2] <- dat$p_y[2] + 0.023
    dat$estimate_y[2] <- dat$ci_y[2] + 0.023
  }
  y_limits <- c(
    min(-0.10, floor((min(dat$conf_low, dat$p_y) - 0.015) / 0.05) * 0.05),
    max(0.25, ceiling((max(dat$conf_high, dat$estimate_y) + 0.015) / 0.05) * 0.05)
  )
  footnote <- paste0(
    "Beide Modelle kontrollieren die Taiwan-Zuordnung.\n",
    "95%-Konfidenzintervalle; zweiseitige t-Tests (OLS). 0 = kein Gruppenunterschied.\n",
    "Korr. R²: M1 = ", decimal(dat$adjusted_r2[1]), "; M2 = ", decimal(dat$adjusted_r2[2]),
    "; Differenz = ", decimal(diff(dat$adjusted_r2), signed = TRUE), "."
  )
  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(dat, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = estimate)) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#9299A1", linewidth = 0.50, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::geom_line(ggplot2::aes(group = 1), colour = "#1B7A60", linewidth = 1.0, alpha = 0.72) +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(ggplot2::aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high, colour = model), width = 0.055, linewidth = 0.90) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(colour = model, shape = model), size = 3.7, stroke = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(x = label_x, y = estimate_y, label = estimate_label, hjust = hjust),
                       colour = "#17212B", family = font_family, fontface = "bold", size = 3.55) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(x = label_x, y = ci_y, label = ci_label, hjust = hjust),
                       colour = "#34414D", family = font_family, size = 2.95) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(x = label_x, y = p_y, label = p_label, hjust = hjust),
                       colour = "#596573", family = font_family, size = 2.95) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c(M1 = "#596573", M2 = "#1B7A60")) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(M1 = 16, M2 = 17)) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0.30, 2.70), breaks = c(1, 2), expand = c(0, 0),
      labels = c("M1: Basismodell\nOhne Themenkontrolle",
                 paste0("M2: Themenkontrolle\nMit ", topic_count, " STM-Themenanteilen"))
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      limits = y_limits, breaks = seq(y_limits[1], y_limits[2], by = 0.05),
      expand = c(0, 0), labels = function(x) decimal(x, digits = 2)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Finanzierungsgruppe und mediale Haltung",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Staatlich / öffentlich finanzierte Medien minus Medien mit anderen Finanzierungsquellen\n",
        "Gruppendifferenz im Stance-Wert  -  N = ", sample_label, " Artikel"
      ),
      x = NULL, y = "Unstandardisierter OLS-Koeffizient b", caption = footnote
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(colour = "none", shape = "none") +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = font_family) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot", plot.caption.position = "plot",
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", colour = "#17212B", margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 5)),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8.3, colour = "#596573", lineheight = 1.25, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 15)),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8.6, colour = "#263440", margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 9)),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "#34414D", margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 4)),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9.1, colour = "#263440", lineheight = 1.2, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 8)),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "#53606C", linewidth = 0.35),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "#53606C", linewidth = 0.35),
      axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(1.3, "mm"),
      plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7.5, colour = "#596573", hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.3, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 12)),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 12, r = 13, b = 10, l = 12),
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    )
  list(plot = plot, data = dat, font_family = font_family)
}

save_funding_coefficient_plot <- function(result, output_dir,
                                         stem = "Path1_2_Coefficient_Comparison_loc",
                                         width_mm = 160, height_mm = 110, dpi = 600) {
  for (package in c("ggplot2", "ragg", "svglite")) {
    if (!requireNamespace(package, quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop("Fehlendes R-Paket: ", package, ". Bitte mit install.packages() installieren.")
    }
  }
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  output <- file.path(output_dir, stem)
  # Showtext-Hooks temporaer entfernen, damit Vektortext editierbar bleibt.
  hook_names <- c("plot.new", "grid.newpage")
  old_hooks <- lapply(hook_names, getHook)
  names(old_hooks) <- hook_names
  on.exit(for (name in hook_names) setHook(name, old_hooks[[name]], action = "replace"), add = TRUE)
  for (name in hook_names) {
    keep <- !vapply(old_hooks[[name]], inherits, logical(1), "showtext_hook")
    setHook(name, old_hooks[[name]][keep], action = "replace")
  }
  draw <- function(open_device) {
    open_device()
    on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE)
    print(result$plot)
  }
  draw(function() grDevices::cairo_pdf(paste0(output, ".pdf"), width = width_mm / 25.4,
                                      height = height_mm / 25.4, family = result$font_family))
  draw(function() svglite::svglite(paste0(output, ".svg"), width = width_mm / 25.4, height = height_mm / 25.4))
  draw(function() ragg::agg_png(paste0(output, ".png"), width = width_mm, height = height_mm,
                               units = "mm", res = dpi, background = "white"))
  draw(function() ragg::agg_tiff(paste0(output, ".tiff"), width = width_mm, height = height_mm,
                                units = "mm", res = dpi, background = "white", compression = "lzw"))
  utils::write.csv(result$data, paste0(output, "_source_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  invisible(result)
}

funding_coef_result <- make_funding_coefficient_plot(model_p1, model_p2)
combined_tidy <- funding_coef_result$data
plot_coef <- funding_coef_result$plot
save_funding_coefficient_plot(funding_coef_result, results_dir)
# END FUNDING_COEFFICIENT_SLOPE
print("Regression visualization plots successfully saved.")

# [Figure 4] Vollstaendiges Forest-Table-Diagramm: Modell 1 vs. Modell 2
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Gemeinsame Routine aus dem Replikationspaket; keine privaten absoluten Pfade.
locate_forest_helper <- function() {
  file_arg <- grep("^--file=", commandArgs(FALSE), value = TRUE)
  input_files <- c(sub("^--file=", "", file_arg), vapply(sys.frames(), function(frame) {
    if (is.null(frame$ofile)) "" else as.character(frame$ofile[1])
  }, character(1)))
  candidates <- c(
    file.path(dirname(input_files[nzchar(input_files)]), "full_model_forest_plot.R"),
    file.path(getwd(), "scripts", "03_main_pipeline", "full_model_forest_plot.R"),
    file.path(getwd(), "Replication_Package", "scripts", "03_main_pipeline", "full_model_forest_plot.R"),
    file.path(getwd(), "full_model_forest_plot.R")
  )
  found <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (!length(found)) stop("full_model_forest_plot.R im Replikationspaket nicht gefunden.")
  normalizePath(found[1])
}
forest_helper <- locate_forest_helper()
source(forest_helper)
forest_topic_csv <- file.path(dirname(forest_helper), "..", "..", "data", "derived", "stm",
                              paste0("seed_", current_seed), "topic_names.csv")
forest_topic_excel <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("topic_summaries_loc_", current_seed, ".xlsx"))
if (file.exists(forest_topic_excel)) {
  forest_topic_names <- readxl::read_excel(forest_topic_excel)
} else if (file.exists(forest_topic_csv)) {
  forest_topic_names <- read.csv(forest_topic_csv, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
} else {
  stop("Themenbezeichnungen fuer den aktuellen Seed fehlen.")
}
forest_result <- make_full_model_forest_plot(model_p1, model_p2, forest_topic_names, current_seed)
plot_forest_table <- forest_result$plot
save_full_model_forest_plot(forest_result, results_dir)
print("Vollstaendiger Forest-Plot fuer den aktuellen Seed gespeichert.")
